name: NOVOS TALENTOS - Gil Brito
description: Gil Brito, a young pianist born in Porto in 2015, performs a classical music concert. He has won 25 first prizes in 27 national and international competitions and was the winner of Got Talent Portugal 2025.
longDescription:
Gil Marques Pratas Borges de Brito, born in Porto in 2015, started playing piano at age 5. Since 2021/22, he has been studying at the Conservatório de Música do Porto with Professor Dina Resende. At 11 years old, Gil Brito has achieved 25 first prizes in 27 national and international competitions, and he was the winner of Got Talent Portugal 2025.

He has performed on significant national and international stages, including Casa da Música, Teatro Capitólio, Teatro Micaelense, Castelo de São Jorge, Beethoven-Haus in Bonn, Rome, Granada, and Paris. Recently, he performed a solo concert with an orchestra at Casa da Música in July 2025, and a solo recital at Maison du Portugal in Paris in October 2025.

The concert at TMP-Rivoli's Pequeno Auditório is scheduled for November 14, 2026, at 15:30, with a duration of 45 minutes. Tickets are priced at 5€ for the stalls.
